metadata.construction: Fixed original complete candidates plus bounded atomic proposals. No fresh generation; no production ranking integration.
metadata.selection: At most six mechanically safe distinct incoming bundles, round-robin sizes 1/2/3, before gameplay outcomes. Holdout never feeds proposal construction or scheduling.
metadata.coupling: SHA256 independent priorities keyed by namespace, seed, canonical card identity and duplicate occurrence. Shared cards keep relative order, not fixed draw positions. No mulligans in paired experiments.
metadata.uncertainty: Exploratory paired bootstrap 95% intervals (2000 resamples), conditional on this model and fixed pilot; no multiplicity correction, ties do not prove equivalence, unsupported outcomes unknown.
metadata.pricing: Exact eligible selected-record Scryfall EUR; owned basics. Not verified Cardmarket EN NM.
